description: Performance optimizations: memoization, reduced re-renders, throttled drag updates, and efficient state management across App.jsx, MiniMap.jsx, and TaskPanel.jsx
steps: STEP 1 - Wrap MiniMap and TaskPanel with React.memo to prevent re-renders when their props haven't changed. MiniMap already receives stable references but re-renders on every parent state change. TaskPanel similarly re-renders unnecessarily.

STEP 2 - Extract the SVG connector/edge rendering into a memoized component (ConnectorLayer or similar) inside App.jsx or as a small inline component wrapped with React.memo. The edge rendering block (around line 4150-4190 in the render) re-renders on every pointer move during drag due to the parent re-rendering. The memoized component should accept edges, nodes, groups, draggingNode, draggingGroup, draggingImage, and the relevant helper functions (getConnectionPoint, drawCurve, removeEdge) as props and only re-render when those specific values change.

STEP 3 - Extract the individual card/node rendering into a memoized NodeCard component (React.memo). Currently each node is rendered inline in the nodes.map() loop. The component should accept: node, theme, isDragging, isFocused, isSelected, connectHoverNodeId, connecting, coords (displayX/displayY), nodeDims, and all handlers. Use React.memo with a custom comparison to skip re-render when the node's relevant props haven't changed. This prevents ALL cards from re-rendering when only one card is being dragged.

STEP 4 - Memoize expensive computed values in App.jsx: (a) memoize 'activeWs' derivation with useMemo dependent on [workspaces, activeTab], (b) memoize 'nodes', 'edges', 'groups' derivation from activeWs with useMemo, (c) memoize the 'stats' computation with useMemo dependent on [nodes].

STEP 5 - Optimize handlePointerMove: During drag operations, the handler calls setDraggingNode which triggers a full re-render. Instead, store drag position ONLY in the ref (draggingNodeRef) during moves and use requestAnimationFrame to batch visual updates. Update the state only at lower frequency or use a ref-based rendering approach for the dragged node's position. Specifically: (a) in handlePointerMove for draggingNode, update ONLY draggingNodeRef.current and use a rAF-throttled state update, (b) for the dragged node's display coordinates, read from draggingNodeRef.current directly.

STEP 6 - Throttle MiniMap updates: MiniMap receives 'transform' as a prop and re-renders on every pan/zoom frame. Add internal throttling in MiniMap.jsx using requestAnimationFrame or a 100ms interval to limit visual updates. Alternatively, pass transform via a ref and use a polling interval inside MiniMap to read the latest value.

STEP 7 - Optimize the computeLayout function: It's called on every node position change (including during drag). Add an early-return check: if no groups have child nodes or subgroups that changed position, skip the expensive computation. Also memoize the result when inputs haven't changed.

STEP 8 - Fix the repeated localStorage.setItem patterns in the auto-save useEffect (around line 800-830). There are two separate useEffects that both write to localStorage on changes - consolidate into a single debounced save. The current code has a 500ms debounce which is good, but the setProjects updater is called redundantly (once for data, once for password). Ensure only one debounced write happens.

STEP 9 - Optimize selection box rendering during multi-select drag: The selectionBox state update in handlePointerMove triggers full re-renders. Use a ref + rAF pattern similar to the node drag optimization.

STEP 10 - Add will-change: transform CSS hint to the canvas transform layer div to promote it to its own compositor layer, improving pan/zoom performance. Add this to the style of the div at around line 4115 that has the transform applied.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes successfully with no errors
No behavioral changes - all existing interactions (drag, pan, zoom, select, connect, edit) work identically
Bundle size does not increase by more than 2KB (memoization adds negligible code)
The MiniMap component is wrapped with React.memo
The TaskPanel component is wrapped with React.memo
The node card rendering uses React.memo
The connector/edge SVG layer uses React.memo
handlePointerMove uses rAF throttling for drag state updates
Canvas transform layer has will-change: transform CSS
verification: Run npm run build and confirm no errors
Verify the dist output is produced successfully
